answer: Sponsor-decay bond: each identity needs a sponsor locking 70 credits in a timber bond, filing a pearl of sponsor work. Auditors check each epoch: clean work earns a pearl, failed audits drive reputation toward its nadir, where the bond halves, revoking the identity. Sponsors back at most 3, so the k-th fake costs 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented sponsors lose pearls. Honest agents pay 40 once, back in 20 epochs.
